tasks.subject: Task 1: voices.mjs — the pure voice model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One pure module that turns a `ui_hierarchy` object into a layout answer and an ordered voice list, and resolves a focused voice from a raw wire value.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/shared/param_pages/voices.mjs`
- Test: `tests/host/test_voices.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `layoutOf()` returns `"drums"`, `"chromatic"`, or `null` — and `null` for an unrecognised string, never a coerced `"chromatic"`
- [ ] `voicesOf()` orders sibling voices by `root`'s nav links, then appends voice levels `root` does not link, in `levels` declaration order
- [ ] `voicesOf()` expands a child level with `child_note_base` into `child_count` voices, and honours `child_notes` for a sparse map
- [ ] A level with no `note` and no note map produces no voice (9W9's Reverb/Delay/Main)
- [ ] `voiceIndexFromNote`, `voiceIndexFromLevel`, `voiceIndexFromChild`, `voiceIndexFromWire` all return `null` rather than 0 for anything they cannot resolve
- [ ] No function in the file reads or writes a param

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_voices.sh` → prints `PASS: voices.mjs` and exits 0

**Steps:** Write the failing test (full source in the plan doc); run it red; implement `voices.mjs` (full source in the plan doc); run it green; mutate `layoutOf` to default to `"chromatic"` and confirm the test catches it; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 3: synth:last_note in the chain host
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The chain host records the MIDI note last played into the slot and serves it, so a module that owns no focus param still lets a consumer resolve the focused voice.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_internal.h` (beside `int synth_consumes_line_input;` at :254)
- Modify: `src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_midi.c` (the `synth->on_midi` loop at :901-906)
- Modify: `src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_host.c` (the `synth:` get_param block, beside `consumes_line_input` at :1690-1694)
- Create: `tests/host/test_chain_last_note.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `synth:last_note` reads `-1` before any note is played
- [ ] A note-on with velocity > 0 updates it; a note-off (`0x80`, or `0x90` with velocity 0) does not
- [ ] The recorded note is the one the SYNTH receives — post-MIDI-FX — not the raw input
- [ ] The record is a plain assignment on the SPI callback: no allocation, no logging, no file I/O
- [ ] Reset to -1 on every synth load, so a stale note cannot name a voice in a list that no longer exists

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_chain_last_note.sh` → `PASS: last_note`

**Steps:** Add the field; reset it at each synth-load site; record in the send-to-synth loop gated on `(status & 0xF0) == 0x90 && vel > 0`; serve it in the `synth:` get_param block; write the source-invariant test (full source in the plan doc, comments stripped before asserting); mutate away the velocity gate and confirm red; `./scripts/build.sh` and confirm the object actually rebuilt (build.sh has exited 0 on failure before); commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_internal.h", "src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_midi.c", "src/modules/chain/dsp/chain_host.c", "tests/host/test_chain_last_note.sh"], "verifyCommand": "bash tests/host/test_chain_last_note.sh && ./scripts/build.sh", "acceptanceCriteria": ["last_note reads -1 before any note", "note-on with velocity>0 updates it, note-off does not", "records the post-MIDI-FX note the synth receives", "no allocation/logging/file IO beside the record", "reset to -1 on synth load"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: The grid follows the focused voice
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The knob grid moves to the focused voice's page for the sibling shape and for the note fallback, on the rotation stop the template shape already rides.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/shared/param_pages/page_controller.mjs` — import block at :32, after `syncChildIndexFromModule` at :1587-1615
- Test: `tests/host/test_voice_follow.sh` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A module declaring `focus_param` moves the grid to the named level's knob page
- [ ] A module declaring neither focus param, but declaring voices, follows `last_note`
- [ ] A module declaring `child_index_param` is untouched — the existing path still owns it, and `last_note` is not read at all
- [ ] A failed read (`null`), an empty answer, or a name that is not a voice moves nothing
- [ ] No new rotation stop: the reads ride the existing one
- [ ] `tests/host/test_child_index_param.sh` still passes unchanged

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_voice_follow.sh` → `PASS: voice follow`, then `for t in tests/host/*.sh; do bash "$t" || echo "BROKE: $t"; done` with no BROKE lines

**Steps:** Write the failing test, reconciling its harness with the real controller API by copying the construction from `tests/host/test_child_index_param.sh`; add the `voices.mjs` import (NOT `layoutOf` — see the plan doc); add `syncVoiceFromModule` (full source in the plan doc) and call it beside `syncChildIndexFromModule`; run green; run the whole `tests/host` suite; commit.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Pin the no-LED rule
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make "the follow path writes no LEDs" a build failure rather than a comment, before someone adds rack lighting in good faith.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/host/test_voice_follow_no_leds.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The test fails if a MIDI-out or LED call appears in `syncVoiceFromModule` or `voices.mjs`
- [ ] The test states WHY in its own output, so the person who trips it learns the rule rather than deleting the assertion
- [ ] Asserts on the function body with comments stripped — an assertion that trips on its own documentation proves nothing
- [ ] The awk range is confirmed to match the real function body (a mutation that goes uncaught means the range matched nothing)

**Verify:** `bash tests/host/test_voice_follow_no_leds.sh` → `PASS: voice follow writes no LEDs`

**Steps:** Write the test (full source in the plan doc); run it; inject a `setLED` into `syncVoiceFromModule` and confirm it goes red — if it does NOT, the awk range is wrong and the pin matches nothing; revert; commit.


tasks.subject: Task 8: POC module and hardware verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the contract functions end to end by being its first consumer — a real module, through the real pipeline, on the device.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

Why it is not optional: the deliverable is a contract other people implement, and Tasks 1–6 construct their subject by hand. Nine tasks and ~100 green assertions once passed on a widget feature that was non-functional, because every test called the registry directly and source pins structurally cannot see call ordering.

**Files:**
- Create: `examples/voice-poc/module.json` — declares both shapes
- Create: `examples/voice-poc/README.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Sibling shape (`layout: drums`, three noted levels, one page with no note) loads; the grid shows the three voices and not the page
- [ ] Template shape shows declared names in the picker, not "Pad 1 … Pad 4"
- [ ] Playing a mapped pad moves the grid to that voice's page — for the `focus_param` module AND for the `last_note` fallback module
- [ ] `synth:last_note` read from the device returns the note last played, and `-1` before any
- [ ] No pad LED changes colour as a result of the grid following — confirmed by eye
- [ ] A module that declares nothing behaves exactly as today (load one fleet module and confirm)
- [ ] Screens confirmed by looking at them, not by reading the code that draws them

**Verify:** off-device first — `node` over `examples/voice-poc/module.json` must print `layout: drums` and voices kick/snare/hat (36/38/42) then four pads (60–63) with NO Reverb; then `node tools/param-pages/preview_knob_card.mjs voice-poc` and look at the render; then on device after asking permission to deploy.

**Steps:** ASK BEFORE DEPLOYING — deploying interrupts whatever Charles is doing on the device. Write the POC module.json (full source in the plan doc); verify off-device; `./scripts/build.sh`; ask; `./scripts/install.sh local --skip-modules --skip-confirmation`; exercise every criterion on hardware; disarm `debug_log_on` when done; report per-criterion including anything that did not work.
